summary: Re-check of v12 width/spacing (frontend only, live URL, hard reload). Width rule now ships: .home-main/.classes-main/.gm-main max-width min(1800px,96vw), so they are 1800px wide at 1920. Content after 32px padding = 90.4% of the viewport, just under the ~92% target, because the 1800px cap is hit before 96vw (1843px). No horizontal overflow. FAIL: at 800px the hero is still 2 columns (294px + 338px, preview to the right). FAIL: the Group Maker Generate button sits right after the size buttons (about x=716 in a card that ends at about x=1492), leaving a large empty area on the right. FAIL: .row-kicker is still 11px (v5.css:188).

ui_bugs.issue: grid-template-columns stays '1fr 1.15fr'. There is no max-width media query after the v12 rule at v5.css:171, so the hero does not stack.
The Generate button is not pushed to the right end. The flex row has no margin-left:auto or space-between, so about half the card is empty on the right.

issues: Content is 90.4% of the viewport (1800px cap minus 64px padding). For >=92%, raise the cap to about 1880px or use just 96vw.

action_items: Add at the end of v5.css: @media (max-width: 900px) { .home-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; } }
Add .gm-controls [data-testid=gm-generate-btn] (or its class) { margin-left: auto; } so the button sits at the right end
Optional: max-width: min(1880px, 96vw) to reach the ~92% content target at 1920

context_for_next_testing_agent: The CSS is in /app/src/v5.css (Vite app, not frontend/). With only one class, Group Maker auto-selects it, so there is no gm-class-card to click. Classes live in browser local storage, so a fresh context has no row-kicker on the hub until you create a class.
